BETWEEN:-
 RAMBABU THAKUR S/O SHRI OMPRAKASH, AGED  ABOUT 32 YEARS, OCCUPATION: LABOUR R/O H.NO.62  VILLAGE ADAMPUR NEAR RAISEN MARG SEHORE
KOLUAKHURD TEHSIL HUZUR DISTRICT BHOPAL  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI VINOD KUMAR YADAV - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION BILKHIRIYA DISTRICT BHOPAL (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI GAJENDRA PARASHAR - PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for hearing this day, the  following:
 ORDER
This repeat application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of bail on the ground that investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed.
2. Applicant has been arrested on 05.12.2023 in connection with Crime No.445/2023 registered by Police Station Bilkhiriya, District Bhopal (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 376, 394, 506 of IPC.
3 . The Supreme Court in the case of Virupakshappa Gouda and another v. State of Karnataka and another, reported in (2017) 5 SCC 406
has held that mere filing of charge sheet cannot be said to be change in circumstance because filing of charge sheet indicates that even police had found that there is prima facie material against accused.
